fact: The red heart of the Scorpion — a vast red supergiant whose ruddy colour earned it the name 'rival of Mars'.
bio: Antares (Alpha Scorpii) is a red supergiant roughly 550 light-years away, hundreds of times the Sun's diameter. Like Betelgeuse it is destined to end as a supernova.
cultural: The Greek name means 'rival of Ares (Mars)', for its Mars-like hue. Many cultures place it at the heart or sting of a great scorpion or serpent along the Milky Way.
